sloka: निर्ययू राक्षसव्याघ्रा नादयन्तो दिशो दश ।राक्षसा भीमकर्माणो रावणस्य जयैषिणः ।। ६.४३.३ ।।।।
transliteration: niryayū rākṣasavyāghrā nādayanto diśo daśa ।rākṣasā bhīmakarmāṇo rāvaṇasya jayaiṣiṇaḥ ।। 6.43.3 ।।।।

translations.english: Wishing victory for Ravana, the tiger among ogres, the Rakshasas of terrific deeds sallied forth accompanied by horses with golden trappings and seizing posts, which were like flames of fire shining like the sun's rays on the chariots and delightful shields, roaring resounding in all the ten directions.
translations.hindi: वहाँ से उसने देखा कि, पर्वतों, वनों और उपवनों सहितः लंका को युद्धाभिलाषी असंख्य वानरों ने घेर लिआ है
